puzzle.hint: The inevitable transition every soul will experience, marking the end of worldly life
puzzle.arabicVerse: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
puzzle.verse: 50:19 - And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
